topic: Three questions to ask on a Dubai school tour that the brochure won't answer

scenes.voiceover: Our mentors have sat on the other side of that table, running school tours.
scenes.image_prompt: A wide school reception area with empty seating

scenes.voiceover: Three questions change the answers you get.
scenes.image_prompt: A printed prospectus lying closed on a table

scenes.voiceover: One. What happens when a student falls behind in maths. Not the policy. The actual sequence of events.
scenes.image_prompt: An empty classroom with chairs tucked under desks

scenes.voiceover: Two. How many students dropped A Level Mathematics after Year twelve. Three. Who teaches the bottom set.
scenes.image_prompt: A school corridor noticeboard with papers pinned in rows

scenes.voiceover: The brochure answers none of these. Which is exactly why our mentors know what the answers reveal.
scenes.image_prompt: Two adults walking through a school courtyard at a distance

caption:
The brochure will not answer these.

1. What actually happens when a student falls behind in maths - the sequence, not the policy.
2. How many students dropped A Level Mathematics after Year 12 last year.
3. Who teaches the bottom set.

Our mentors have run these tours from the other side.

Save this before your next Dubai school tour.
